examples.explanation: Block notation: Renders small monochrome characters into the ePaper buffer without refreshing it. Command; six-pixel character spacing and clipped text at the edge.

examples.title: Write then refresh ePaper
examples.code:
set ready to (P2 IL3820 MOSI [8] clock [9] CS [10] DC [11] reset [12] busy [13])
if [ready]
  P2 ePaper clear buffer black [false]
  P2 ePaper text [Hello P2] x [0] y [0]
  P2 ePaper update (false on timeout)
examples.explanation: Match all six pins to real wiring and ensure they are free. Inspect the final Boolean; a buffered drawing alone does not refresh the panel.
